Profound and Deep poem!

“To kiss the grave of my other-half

to let her know her lost son is found”

Wow… what a sadistic pleasure! These two lines pierced my already grieving heart.

How?

Real pain i am with

comes in the mind of another unknown

and makes as if I myself is writing my own loss.

Dear Poet, I have found our lost child many months after my wife left us.  The cause of her demise was he. This poem shall remain in my mind as a ever read master piece. May god bless you. Salute your pen.
very well written though I am no critic! I am the last person to write poems on this planet! keep it up and share with the world..

त्यही भूटानको कानुनको निलो किताबको एक पानामा १९५७-१९५८ का ती दुर्लभ रसिद, राजाको बिहेमा तिरेको चन्दाको चिर्कटो, चारै राजाको तस्बिर र मसी सुकेको पुरानो त्यो कलम बजैका निधारका चाउरी परेका घेरा हेर्दै भूटानको “समग्र राष्ट्रिय खुसीयाली” सम्झँदै च्यापी दिएँ र त्यही च्याप-च्याप गर्ने झोलाभित्र राखी दिएँ |

This story touched my core of heart and inner conscience. The protagonist, an elderly grand ma represents real mass of common innocent women, who are out of the root. Rootless is the plight and root is in her retrospection, always. 

The use of local dialect and the expression sound real. so is the theme and narration of an antique bag, a symbol of history that can never be erased, though it is seared and bleared. An aesthetically sound story. I must salute to this story writer.  

a challenge to those, who are in the favor of ‘the end of history’!
